run_audio_transforms_unit_tests: run the unittest suite for all AugLy audio augmentation transforms
test_Compose_audio_transforms: test composing multiple audio transforms like Clip and ChangeVolume in sequence
test_OneOf_audio_transforms: test randomly selecting one audio transform from a list of candidates
test_PitchShift_transform: test the PitchShift audio augmentation transform with a specified number of semitone steps
test_TimeStretch_transform: test the TimeStretch audio augmentation transform with a specified stretch rate
